newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares pushed down by Terme.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares pushed down by Terme.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.38 percent on Tuesday, dragged lower by what traders interpreted as a downward correction in Terme Catez.
Dealers forecast prices would hold around current levels in the absence of fresh news.
* The SBI index fell 4.99 points to 1,316.04.
* Health resort operator Terme Catez led the day's decliners and fell 5.36 percent to 12,000 tolars on volume of 15 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
